question: Who or what may be included in the action performed in the middle of the heart lotus?
premises: The action occurs in the middle of the heart lotus.
Others, including śambaras, may also be included.
inference: In the middle of the heart lotus, the action may include oneself and also others, the śambaras.
uncertainties: The term śambarān is contextually unclear in this ritual passage.
plain_english: Then, in the middle of the heart lotus, of oneself and also others, the śambaras.
